in_marathi.name: Sayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sayan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sayas' which means 'bed' or 'restful'. It is also associated with the Moon god, symbolizing calmness and tranquility.
